cold_start_protocol.input_policy: A frozen batch-size-1 deterministic Stage26 synthetic input is used for first prediction.
cold_start_protocol.jit_policy: Any first-call framework/JIT initialization belongs to first_prediction_ms and cold total. It is excluded only from warm steady-state timing after frozen warmup.
cold_start_protocol.process_semantics: Each repetition launches a fresh Python interpreter using subprocess exec semantics. multiprocessing fork reuse is forbidden.

no_post_result_adaptation: no dropping slow models because they are slow

resource_failure.backend_unavailable: Record BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE. Do not retrain, convert, or substitute another model.
resource_failure.out_of_memory: Record RESOURCE_LIMIT_OOM. Do not reduce batch size post hoc for that condition.
resource_failure.serialization_incompatible: Block affected target. A narrowly scoped compatibility adapter may be written only if it does not change artifact bytes, model parameters, input representation, or measurement policy.
resource_failure.timeout: Record TIMEOUT_RESOURCE_LIMIT after 600 seconds. Do not alter iteration counts post hoc.

required_before_first_extraction_measure: packet count or exact packet bounds
extraction_protocol_gate.scientific_rule: No extraction timing may begin until a separate stage26_extraction_protocol.json is frozen. That subprotocol may not be chosen using Stage26 latency results.

gpu_handoff_protocol.backend_policy: Benchmark only already-valid officially supported GPU inference execution paths. If a frozen model family has no valid GPU inference path in the runtime, record BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE. Do not retrain or convert merely to force GPU support.
gpu_handoff_protocol.gpu_timing_rule: GPU work must be synchronized immediately before timer start and immediately before timer stop. Asynchronous launch timing without synchronization is invalid.
gpu_handoff_protocol.reason: Kaggle accelerator switch resets the session; CPU work must be fully persisted and git-anchored before enabling GPU.

hypotheses_not_protocol_truths: feature extraction may or may not dominate
tree models may or may not dominate
CNN may or may not be Pareto dominated
ViT may or may not be Pareto dominated
GPU may or may not materially improve deployment cost

construction.ft_transformer_input: Use Z as the already-scaled FT-Transformer model input.
construction.scaled_matrix_Z: Z ~ Normal(0,1), deterministic from frozen seed derived from batch size.
construction.shared_rows_rule: At each batch size, trees and FT-Transformer derive their inputs from the exact same underlying Z rows.
construction.tree_input_X_raw: X_raw = scaler.mean_ + Z * scaler.scale_. This preserves Stage15 training-feature scale without labels or holdout access.

model_boundary.exact_forward_inputs: Worker must use the original frozen architecture's required forward signature. If padding mask is required, it is passed exactly; if not required, it is not added.

packet_recipe.protocol: Deterministic TCP/UDP mixture; protocol values 6 and 17.

general.reason: Model-only inference profiling must isolate execution cost from feature/preprocessing cost and must not reopen a predictive holdout solely for benchmarking.

cpu_metrics.baseline_rss: RSS after required framework imports and input preparation, before model load.
cpu_metrics.loaded_rss: RSS after model load and before inference.
cpu_metrics.peak_rss: Maximum sampled process RSS during memory-only inference run.
cpu_metrics.ru_maxrss: Recorded descriptively inside the isolated process.

package_size.deployment_package_size: Sum of model/checkpoint artifacts plus model-specific required preprocessing/configuration/architecture artifacts. Generic Python/framework installation size is excluded.
package_size.serialized_model_size: Actual immutable model/checkpoint bytes on disk.

next_permitted_actions: Create durable Stage26-0C git commit containing this protocol lock and execution plan.
Push and verify the protocol commit remotely.
Only after remote verification: run Stage26 CPU execution preflight without timing.
Only after preflight passes: begin randomized CPU profiling.

dominance_rule.A_dominates_B_if: A PR-AUC >= B PR-AUC and A p95 latency <= B p95 latency, with at least one strict inequality.
dominance_rule.frontier_status: Descriptive point-estimate frontier; bootstrap uncertainty reported separately.

operational_references.ENS_LGBM_XGB_EQUAL: May be shown as operational reference but does not increase architecture-family candidate count.
operational_references.FT_BALANCED_SINGLE_RESOURCE_REFERENCE: Resource decomposition only; excluded from predictive Pareto.

scientific_success_criterion: Stage 26 succeeds when every frozen architecture receives a reproducible resource profile under the same declared hardware and measurement semantics, feature-extraction cost is explicitly separated from inference cost, and Pareto claims are restricted to scientifically comparable evaluation populations.

statistics_protocol.maximum_policy: Maximum latency is descriptive only and is not used for Pareto dominance.

backend_thread_rules.catboost: thread_count = frozen thread count for CPU prediction
backend_thread_rules.lightgbm: num_threads = frozen thread count where mutable for inference
backend_thread_rules.xgboost: n_jobs = frozen thread_count where mutable for inference

thread_policy.smt_policy: Affinity uses one logical CPU per distinct physical core where sysfs topology is available.
thread_policy.worker_rule: Every benchmark worker sets each supported thread environment variable to the frozen condition thread_count before importing numerical/ML frameworks.

ensemble_rules.ENS_LGBM_XGB_EQUAL: Operational classical ensemble latency includes both LightGBM and XGBoost probability generation plus equal-weight probability averaging.
ensemble_rules.FT_BALANCED_5_CHECKPOINT_SOFT_VOTING: Primary FT latency includes all five checkpoint forward passes plus unweighted arithmetic probability averaging.
ensemble_rules.FT_BALANCED_SINGLE_RESOURCE_REFERENCE: Single seed-7 checkpoint only; resource decomposition only; not eligible for predictive Pareto claims.

timed_boundary.T_decision: Threshold application is excluded from primary T_infer. It may be recorded separately as descriptive decision overhead.
timed_boundary.T_end_to_end: T_extract + T_preprocess + T_infer, only where the extraction pipeline is scientifically compatible.
timed_boundary.T_infer: Prepared model input -> materialized attack probability output.
timed_boundary.T_preprocess: Required model-boundary transforms only. Measured separately from inference.

warm_protocol.p99_policy: p99 is a primary tail statistic only for conditions with at least 100 timed observations. It may not be promoted from the 20- or 50-sample large-batch conditions.
